wolf spiders.desc:
Two large spiders covered in gray hair stares at you with 6 evil red eyes. They are as big as you are and their mandibles are thicker than your arms. You are having a hard time just standing still.
Your brain is telling you to run, but it is too late. You can't run from these.

two feral humans.desc: A feral human wearing rags engages you. It observes you carefully, as if hunting an animal.

Sparring Scobby.desc: He is wielding a sparring stick. He is way more bulkier than you and will destroy you if you make him mad.

Teaching Scobby.desc:
Scobby: [Alright. Let me teach you about targeting. Tap on this text area to access the targeting options.]

Scobby: [You'll see the option to target me, followed by my health status. When you are facing more than one enemies, you will have a better use for this mode.
Anyways, let's continue.]

three ants.desc: Ants with the size of a toddler crawl towards you. They constantly wiggle their long antennae on their heads. Ants are usually not too aggressive, but these seem to be startled by your presence.

millipede.desc: A worm-like monster with countless legs slithers its way towards you.

pill bug.desc: An armored bug shaped like an uncurled ball crawls towards you.

caterpillar.desc: A fat worm with fabulous hair crawls toward you. You probably don't want to touch that.

two bloodquitos.desc: Two flying insect monsters bigger than your head are flying toward you. Their giant blood red eyes are staring at you with malice. Their thin wings covered with black veins flap slowly at their sides. Six lanky legs stick forward, shivering with excitement for blood. These are the infamous Bloodquitos - they can and will drink you dry!

three bloodquitos.desc: Three flying insect monsters bigger than your head are flying toward you. Their giant blood red eyes are staring at you with malice. Their thin wings covered with black veins flap slowly at their sides. Six lanky legs stick forward, shivering with excitement for blood. These are the infamous Bloodquitos - they can and will drink you dry!

bloodquito.desc: A bloodquito is flying toward you, its giant blood red eyes fixed on you with malice. Its thin wings covered with black veins flap slowly at its sides. Its lanky legs shiver with excitement for blood. It can and will drink you dry!

centipede.desc: A monster with numerous segments of bodies and legs charges at you. Its huge mandibles will make sure you won't get out of here in one piece.

two ticks.desc: Two tiny blood red ticks crawl toward you. They are slow to move, but will suck your blood dry if you let them too close. They are filled with blood and will explode in your face on death.

moth.desc: A giant winged beast slowly flaps its wings toward you. Every time it flaps its huge wings, green particles scatter out from its wing hair.

squirrel.desc: A mean looking beast with a tail taller than you. Not very aggressive, but still pretty hard to kill.

yellow butterfly.desc: A giant monster with wings bigger than you slowly flaps its wings as it descends. Its extremely long proboscis looks pretty sharp.

three yellow ants.desc: Three yellow ants with the size of a toddler crawl towards you. These yellow ants look much more aggressive compared to normal ants.

bee.desc: A yellow bumble bee flies toward you. It's cute looking.

bee and bloodquito.desc: A cute yellow bumble bee flies toward you. It's brought a friend.

beetle.desc: A giant blue beetle with beautiful large horn is grazing on the field. It looks uninterested in you, but you insist on fighting it. It sighs and confronts you.

feral hunters.desc: A group of feral humans wielding chitin spears approach you with malicious intent. They do not seem to understand you.

wolf spider.desc:
A large spider covered in gray hair crawls toward you. It is as big as you are and its mandibles are thicker than your arms. You are having a hard time just standing still.
Your brain is telling you to run, but it is too late. You can't run from these.

henge guards.desc:
A Stone Henge guard in full chitin armor equipped with a chitin shield and chitin mace blocks your way. Behind him are two Stone Henge scouts with bows ready to shoot you down.
They look pretty disciplined.

henge wizard.desc: A Stone Henge guard wearing a strange robe blocks your way. He is wielding a glowing staff.

rat.desc:
A ferocious beast bigger than you with huge front teeth approach you.
Rats are dangerous predators that can charge and shred you in seconds. Beware!

rotting pile.desc:
You find a rotting pile of who-knows-what in a small concave dirt area behind a boulder.
The rotting pile is infested with pill bugs and worms.

ant swarm.desc:
A swarm of ants are running for you right now.
They must've run out of things to feed their queen.

stone henge arena.desc:
You are at the training grounds.

There are many Stone Henge guards and hunters sparring in the arena.
One of the participants approach you for a fight.

ant hill priest guards.desc:
You are fighting Ant Hill guards in full chitin armor.
These familiar guards that you've seen around your whole life have never looked so threatening before...

fish.desc:
A giant dark shadow under the surface approach you.
It will leap out of the water at any time you swallow you whole.

elite feral hunters.desc: A group of feral humans wielding chitin halberds approach you fiercely. They are wearing some fancy pink leather over their shoulders that seem to represent their elite status.

feral ambushers.desc: A group of feral humans ambush you from the darkness. They probably didn't like you trying to steal their food.

feral ambushers 2.desc: A group of feral humans ambush you from the darkness. They probably didn't like you trying to steal their food.

feral ambushers 3.desc: A group of feral humans and their domesticated red ticks ambush you from the darkness. They probably didn't like you trying to steal their food.

zombies.desc: A group of bloated, burnt corpses are somehow standing on its own... It looks like they have sensed you somehow and approach you.

zombie.desc: A bloated, burnt corpse somehow standing on its own... It has sensed you and wants to eat you alive.

Cheese the hoarder.desc:
Cheese transforms into a purple shade.
He will not give up the staff that he found, and you know that you must use force to take it from him.

amalgamation.desc:
A mound of limbs and flesh forming one organism.
It is covered in algae at the top and glowing mushrooms everywhere else.

The monstrosity covers long distances when moving, and you realize that running away is not an option when you're this close.
